data.standardized_narrative: During 2023 the syndicate recorded adverse prior-year reserve development, with an explicit deterioration of $18.252m in claims reserves for losses incurred at the prior year end. The movement largely reflects adverse claims development across multiple long-tail and specialty classes (notably Aviation, Property Binder, Marine Hull, Offshore Energy, Non-Marine Liability and Specialty Disruption) and provisions related to the Russia/Ukraine conflict. This prior-year strengthening offset some of the underwriting-year performance, although current year catastrophe losses (e.g. Cyclone Gabrielle and Hurricane Idalia) were contained within the syndicate's catastrophe allowances.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken directly from the 2022 comparative on the balance sheet (Claims outstanding $819,767k). The only explicit prior-year movement amount stated in the annual accounts is worded as a deterioration of $18,252,000 within 'net calendar year claims incurred' (this appears to be a net figure referenced in the technical note). No explicit GROSS 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' figure was found separately; therefore the prior_year_development_gbp_m uses the stated $18.252m (net wording) and has reduced confidence. A gross claims development triangle is present and has been captured; if a strict gross prior-year movement is required it should be derived from the gross triangle (noting RITC and other distortions may apply). All monetary figures converted from $'000 to millions and reported in the native currency (USD).
